Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 19 October 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Tarlac, Pampanga, Cavite, Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, San Antonio, Zaragoza, Licab, Guimba, Nampicuan, Cuyapo, Talugtug, Quezon, Aliaga, San Isidro, Lupao, Carranglan, San Jose, Munoz, Pantabangan, Santa Rosa, Jaen, Bongabon, Gabaldon) and Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Mabini, Nasugbu, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Tuy, Lipa, Mataasnakahoy, Balete, Malvar, Santo Tomas).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Quezon, Laguna, Nueva Ecija(Gapan, General Tinio, Cabanatuan, General Mamerto Natividad, Laur, Llanera, Palayan, Penaranda, Rizal, San Leonardo, Talavera, Santo Domingo) and Batangas(San Juan, Rosario, Padre Garcia, Taysan, Lobo, Batangas City, Ibaan) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
